lines.en: I walk on the snow with shallow prints
My legs are pressed snow
My steps make no sound at all

lines.zh: 雪从我的鬃毛里掉下来
lines.en: Snow falls out of my mane
I walk toward the light

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩下去，雪就化了
lines.en: Where my hooves land, snow melts
I go around a patch of ice

lines.zh: 我的身体在雪里不太显眼
lines.en: I don't stand out in the snow
I stop and shake myself
I leave my shape in the snow

lines.zh: 我走过一段结霜的篱笆
lines.en: I pass a frosted fence
I head for the stable

lines.zh: 我的蹄印很快被雪盖住
lines.en: Snow covers my tracks quickly
I walk over frosted grass
I walk toward the lamp at the door
I step so lightly the snow holds
I stand and snow settles on my back
My body grows colder
I don't sweat, and don't feel cold
Frost has formed on my mane
I lower my head and my nose touches snow
I wait here for the snow to stop
Snow bends my ears a little
I hardly breathe
Everything is quiet, like white paper
I'm made of snow, not alive
My shadow is faint
I stand and let the snow cover me
Someone coughs far off
I don't fear melting; I fear falling
I bury my nose in the snow
Fine frost beads my mane
Your breath is very white
You smell warm
Too close and I'll melt
You reach out and I edge back
My eyes are two pits in the snow
There's ice under you; go slowly
Do you mean to mount me
My back is cold
Put your hand on and you'll know
I wait for you to speak first
There's only winter here
I'll stay with you until the snow stops
A chunk of snow falls off me
I rock and my hooves grip
A leg sags a little
The snow on me starts to drip
I retreat, leaving wet marks
Not even the snow sounds beneath me
My head stays hanging low
I slowly straighten
A dent appears in me
I'm still pinned there, unmoved
What you hold is warm
The warmth beads water on me

lines.zh: 我脚下的雪已经开始化。
lines.en: The snow under me has begun to melt.
I'll melt into a puddle
Keep away from my legs

lines.zh: 这东西的甜味我也闻得到
lines.en: I can smell the sweetness too
But I can't eat it
Just put it further off
I've backed into the shade
It's cooler in the shade
Steam comes off what you hold
Keep hot things away from me

lines.zh: 我的表面已经开始湿了
lines.en: My surface is already wet
Set it down on the snow
Let it cool first

lines.zh: 热的东西一近，我就冒水。
lines.en: Anything warm makes me bead with water.
You bump me and snow falls off

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，蹄子滑了一下
lines.en: I rock and my hooves slip
Your glove brushes me and comes away wet
I step back into soft snow

lines.zh: 你从我身边挤过去，带着暖气
lines.en: You squeeze past, carrying warmth
My mane has collapsed
I shake myself and it puffs up
Pits appear in the snow
My four hooves are set
I'm truly not angry
A horse stands across the snow
It's white all over too
We both puff white breath

lines.zh: 它靠近时我发现它也冷
lines.en: As it comes close, I feel it's cold too

lines.zh: 我们把头放在对方肩上
lines.en: We rest our heads on each other's shoulders

lines.zh: 雪落在我们之间，化了一点
lines.en: Snow between us melts a little
We stand together, still

lines.zh: 这地方看起来不那么空了
lines.en: The place looks less empty
We wait for the next person

lines.zh: 两个人一起站，就不那么冷
lines.en: Standing together, we're less cold
I lower my head and take it up
It's warm in my mouth

lines.zh: 我把它放下，雪化了一块
lines.en: I set it down and snow melts beneath
I can't eat this
A little sticks to my nose
It rolls by my hooves
I push it along with my nose
It drops into a snow pit
I watch it a while
Then I walk away
You've raised the fire
The firelight makes me back off
My surface starts to drip
I stand before the stable
This ground is ours
I retreat step by step, not in flight
Don't keep holding that up
I angle toward the stable
I let my head sink
I can hold a while longer
I stand at the stable door and don't move

lines.zh: 火光靠近，我滴水更厉害
lines.en: The fire nears and I drip more
I give half a hoof, then hold
A piece of me is missing
I haven't given half a step
My legs grow softer

lines.zh: 我抬起雪做的脑袋看你
lines.en: I lift my snow-made head to you
If only you'd put the fire down
We wouldn't have to do this
I'm still in the doorway
My snow hoof slams down beside your feet.
It lands on your chest
Snow breaks off me
I toss my head and my mane cracks at you
You retreat and slip
I shoulder you with packed snow
That cost me an ear
I block with my body

lines.zh: 我撞在门上，雪落了一地
lines.en: I hit the door and snow falls
I haven't melted yet

lines.zh: 我从积雪里拱出一个背。
lines.en: I push a back up out of the drift.
I rise out of the snow

lines.zh: 我身上还挂着未化的雪。
lines.en: Unmelted snow still clings to me.
My outline starts blurred

lines.zh: 马厩门口多了一匹白的
lines.en: A white horse appears at the stable

lines.zh: 冷空气跟着我一起过来
lines.en: Cold air comes with me

lines.zh: 我站定了，四蹄陷进雪里
lines.en: I stand, four hooves in the snow
My breath is white too
Frost beads my mane
A snow horse — my hoofprints are empty.
Fire nears and half of me melts
I fall and scatter into snow
Water soaks me and I go softer

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹成一团白雾
lines.en: The blast blows me into white mist

lines.zh: 箭扎进我身上，留了个洞
lines.en: The arrow buries in me and leaves a hole

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的雪结成了冰
lines.en: That force freezes my snow to ice

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我也撑不久
lines.en: I don't eat, and I won't last long

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，雪都跳起来
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the snow leaps off me
No snow below; I come apart
